title: After Most Migrants Leave Ceuta, Exhausted Holdouts Find Shelter on Beach
summary_full: Most of the people who surged into Spain on Thursday have since returned to Morocco. A small minority are holed up on a seafront, tired, hungry and vowing to stay.
